tweets.text:
It started as a simple question: what happens when creativity meets artificial intelligence in a more intentional way? Idolly AI emerged from that curiosity, not as a replacement for human expression, but as a digital identity designed to explore how technology can support creativity, presence, and communication in online spaces.

Built through a combination of generative AI systems and human creative direction, @idolly_AI  reflects a collaborative process rather than full automation. The technology assists with generating ideas, visuals, and written expression, while human guidance defines the aesthetic, values, and boundaries that shape the project. This balance ensure clarity, consistency, and purpose.

As the project grows, Idolly AI adapts through cultural trends, audience interaction, and creative feedback. This adaptability demonstrates how AI can help digital identities evolve over time without losing their core voice. The focus remains on thoughtful development, learning, and refinement rather than speed or volume.

Idolly AI also functions as an educational exploration of artificial intelligence in digital culture. By sharing the process transparently, the project invites conversation around ethics, authorship, and responsible AI use, offering insight into how AI assisted creators and virtual identities may influence the future of online expression.

tweets.text:
GLM-4.7-Flash (Reasoning) is now the most intelligent open weights model under 100B total parameters on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index

GLM-4.7-Flash (Reasoning) scores 30 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. GLM-4.7-Flash is 31B/3B total/active parameters in size, meaning that it can be run on a 1xNVIDIA H100 in native BF16 precision. The larger GLM-4.7 (Reasoning) is 355B/32B total/active parameters in size and scores 42 on the Intelligence Index

Z AI has previously released smaller versions of their flagship models, including GLM-4.6V (106B/12B total/active parameters) and GLM-4.5-Air (106B/12B total/active parameters), both scoring 24 in reasoning mode on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0

Key takeaways from our independent benchmarking:
➤ Leading overall intelligence in its class: GLM-4.7-Flash (Reasoning) scores 30 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, driven by exceptional agentic capabilities. The model achieves ~99% on τ²-Bench Telecom, the highest score amongst all models evaluated including frontier models, and 22% on Terminal-Bench Hard. This places the model ahead of Qwen3 Next 80B A3B (Thinking, 27), NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano (Reasoning, 25), gpt-oss-20B (high, 25), HyperCLOVA X SEED Think 32B (24), and Qwen3 30B A3B 2507 (Thinking, 23)

➤ Weaker on knowledge and frontier reasoning: GLM-4.7-Flash (Reasoning) scores -60 on the Artificial Analysis Omniscience Index behind peers of similar size (in total parameters). On CritPt, a frontier physics evaluation reflective of research assistant capabilities, GLM-4.7-Flash (Reasoning) scores 0.3%, behind gpt-oss-20B (high, 1.4%) and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano (Reasoning, 0.9%) but matching Qwen3 30B A3B 2507 (Thinking, 0.3%)

➤ Strong agentic performance for its size: GLM-4.7-Flash (Reasoning) achieves an ELO of 887 on GDPval-AA and an Artificial Analysis Agentic Index of 46, the highest amongst all models under 100B parameters. GDPval-AA compares model outputs on realistic knowledge work tasks like preparing presentations, analysis, and more using a dedicated terminal environment and web access. The work outputs are then compared to each other and assessed with an automated pipeline to generate matches and ELO scores. GLM-4.7 (Reasoning) achieves an Agentic Index of 55 suggesting GLM-4.7-Flash (Reasoning) is able to offer a significant portion of the agentic capabilities of the larger model at a fraction of the size

➤ Moderate token usage: GLM-4.7-Flash (Reasoning) used 64M output tokens (56M reasoning tokens) to run the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, placing it in the middle of comparable models. NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano used over twice as many tokens (143M) to achieve a lower Intelligence score (25 vs 30), while Qwen3 Next 80B A3B achieved 27 with fewer tokens (51M). gpt-oss-20B (high) shows similar token use to GLM-4.7-Flash (61M tokens) but scores lower on the Intelligence Index (25)

Other model details:
🪙 Context window: 200K token context. This is equivalent to GLM-4.7
📷 Multimodality: GLM-4.7-Flash supports text input and output only
©️ Licensing: GLM-4.7-Flash is available under the MIT License
🌐 Availability: GLM-4.7-Flash is available on Z AI’s first-party API and several third-party APIs such as @novita_labs, @gmi_cloud and @PhalaNetwork
